caption: The drawing shows three line illustrations of spoons placed horizontally on a beige background. The topmost spoon is depicted from a top-down view, with a broad, rounded bowl tapering into a flat handle that has a trapezoidal end, marked with the word "WESCHLER". The middle spoon is also shown from above and has a similarly shaped bowl and handle but is distinct with an ornate design on the handle, including some decorative leaves and what appears to be a monogram inside a bordered shape at the end. The bottom spoon is presented in a side profile view, exhibiting a curved handle and a shallow, rounded bowl. The drawing is done entirely in thin black lines, with no shading or color variation, and the background shows some slight yellowing or discoloration around the edges. In the bottom left corner is the text “WALT CONK” written in uppercase letters.
title: Silver Spoon
